description:
The issue-code catalog for rental-unit turnover findings (group.issue codes such as carpet.pet_urine). Inputs, all optional: q (search words or a code), group (e.g. flooring), limit, include_aliases; query and area are older names for q and group. With no arguments it returns every code in short form (code, name, group, default extent, refer-out). With q it returns the best matches with description, aliases, not_when, rooms and examples. Returns the codes, the match count, every group, and general.manual_quote, the code for a condition no other code fits. Not for: cost estimates, legal or security-deposit questions, work other than rental turnover.
Deterministic and source-cited: the same input gives the same result.

area.description: Older name for group; use group.

audit.description: Also return the run record and input/result hashes (an audit trail). Default false.

client_refs.description: Your own reference ids (e.g. unit_id, job_id). Echoed back, never used.

expect_ruleset.description: Optional. The ruleset version you built against, as results carry it in provenance.ruleset_version (e.g. 'sd-2026.11.14'), or its sha256: hash. If the rules have changed since, the call fails (nothing computed, nothing charged) and says what is in force now, so you upgrade on your own schedule. Leave it out to answer under the current rules.

group.description: Only codes in this group, e.g. 'flooring' or 'walls' (a part of the unit, not a room). `groups` in the answer lists them all.

include_aliases.description: Also return aliases in the short list (search hits always carry them).

limit.description: Most codes to return. Default: 8 with q, every code without.

q.description: Words to search for in the codes, names, aliases, descriptions and examples, e.g. 'pet stain carpet'. Hits come back with full detail. Leave out to list every code in short form.

query.description: Older name for q; use q.

serve_pinned.description: Optional, with expect_ruleset. True asks us to answer under the ruleset version you named even when the rules have changed since, from that version's signed bundle; the result says so in served_from_bundle. We refuse a version older than 12 months, one a later correction or law change replaced for your state, or one we have no bundle for. Default false: the call fails whenever the rules have changed.

name: property_turnover_issue_codes
title: Look up turnover issue codes
